title: Power loop execution
statement: Fix natural numbers $E$ and $B$, an oracle that assigns a Boolean answer to each of four deciders and each Boolean word, and an input Boolean word $x$. For every natural number $j$ and every state $st$ of the eighteen-register machine, suppose the exponent counter is $X=j$, the loop counter and scratch registers satisfy $C=T=Z=0$, every register is at most $B$, $1\le a$, and $P a^j\le B$. Then the machine starting at the power-loop instruction, with register values given by $st$ and no answer recorded, reaches the copy routine that sets the window radius, with $X=0$, $P=P_{st}a_{st}^j$, all other registers unchanged, and no answer recorded. Every configuration strictly before that endpoint satisfies the guard that the machine’s instruction precondition holds and every register is at most $B$.
hypotheses_covered: oracle on four deciders and Boolean words
all initial registers at most B
